title: One-letter-misspelled keyword alphabets (8.1M) and other alphabet constructions (1.7M) through the full key-rule battery, plus a Quagmire IV join for the new constructions
k4_result: Battery: 2 passes in 9,792,429 new alphabets (chance expects 0.32), both exactly 7 checks and one coincidence: alphabet DISABLETFILL (from DISABLEDFILL), AZ/M Beaufort, two stacked keys p=6 with q=13 or 39 (nested lengths). Too few letters fixed to read (4 new quadgrams). Nothing at 8+ checks. Part 1 (misspellings): 2 passes / 8,130,513 (chance 0.27). Part 2 (other constructions): 0 / 1,661,916 (chance 0.05). Join (Quagmire IV, key length 1-20, 2,328,909 alphabets per side, 9.96e12 new pairs and forms per length): 133 matches (81 at p=16, 52 at p=19); best reading -7.24 on the big model (English needs -5.1).
controls: 3 shuffled K4s on the battery, each on a different 1/6 slice (1,632,072 alphabets): 0 / 0 / 0 passes (chance 0.05 each). Full join: 1,375 / 1,819 / 650 matches, best readings -7.21 / -7.11 / -7.44 (K4 -7.24). Match counts per key length depend on repeated clue letter pairs, not on the cipher: K4 has a free check at p=19 (positions 27 and 65 are both R->P), and contradictions at p=17 and 18 that rule out every alphabet pair there.
planted: 6/6. Sliding key 7 on PALIMPCEST, progressive key 8 on DESPARATLY, plain autokey lag 5 on KRYPTOS with the reversed tail, stacked pair 5+9 on TESTRESULTS with the wrap tail, repeating key 17 on the misspelling RFCREATING (from RECREATING): each searched over the true alphabet plus 3,000 random ones. Only the true alphabet passed, and its top-check setting read back 97/97 (English -4.35 to -4.94). Join plant (plain SHELYAK@swapAE, cipher RESLAY~keyed, key 14) searched over the full 2.3M x 2.3M join: ranked first of 32,019 matches, -4.58 against -7.16 for the next, read back 90/97 (7 letters not fixed by key 14). In the main run, 2 plants were marked 'NOT CLEAN' by a rule that was too strict (sister settings on the true alphabet; chance join matches). The rule was fixed and the plants rerun with the same seed (--plants-only).
scope_limits: Part 1: only one spelling change (replace, drop, double, swap neighbours), and only for KRYPTOS, the 85 theme words and the 21,425 common words; two or more changes, and misspellings of rarer words, are not covered. Each misspelt word gives only the plain keyword alphabet and its two transposition-mixed forms. Part 2 constructions are listed exactly (reverse tail, wrap tail after the last keyword letter, repeated letters kept at their last place, keyword at the end, the four K1-K3 letter swaps applied to the plain keyword alphabet); they were not combined with each other or with the mixed forms. Battery as in idea 120 (repeating 1-17, sliding 1-15, progressive 1-12, autokey lags 1-6, chain addition, stacked pairs exactly, idea-104 fixes), 5 layouts, Vigenere/Beaufort, 7+ checks. Idea 104's gap/mod/multiplier/drop/word-break variants were not run. The join used part-2 alphabets only (not part 1, 8.1M, too large for the join), key lengths 1-20, with dictionary x dictionary left to attack 63. Controls ran on 1/6 slices, not 1/3, to keep the run under an hour.

negative.family: keyword alphabets outside the dictionary (misspellings, other constructions)
negative.hypothesis: K4 is an ordinary keyword-tableau cipher (repeating, sliding, progressive, autokey, chain or two stacked key words) whose alphabet comes from a misspelt keyword or a non-standard way of finishing the alphabet, so no dictionary test could list it.
negative.scope: 8,130,513 new alphabets from every one-letter change (replace/drop/double/swap) of KRYPTOS, 85 theme words and 21,425 common words (keyword alphabet and both transposition mixes); 1,661,916 new alphabets from 236k vocabulary words built with a reversed tail, a wrapped tail, last-place repeats, the keyword at the end, or the K1-K3 swaps Q/L, U/O, A/E, C/S; all through the idea-120 battery (5 layouts, vig/beau, 7+ checks); plus a Quagmire IV hash join of the part-2 alphabets against the 667k dictionary alphabets (both sides), key length 1-20.
negative.outcome: Dead: battery 2 passes in 9.79M alphabets at exactly 7 checks (chance 0.32), one unreadable coincidence (DISABLETFILL, stacked p=6 with q=13/39); join best reading -7.24 (controls: battery 0/0/0 on 1.63M each; join best -7.21/-7.11/-7.44; planted 6/6, each the only alphabet passing and read back 97/97, join plant ranked 1st of 32k).

follow_ups: Run the Quagmire IV join for the 8.1M part-1 misspelling alphabets: it needs a disk-backed or sharded table (about 10M signatures per key length) rather than an in-memory dict per worker.

Two-change misspellings of the 85 theme words alone (about 1-2M alphabets) would fit the same battery in about 5 minutes, and would cover DESPARATLY-type double errors in words other than the four known ones.
